hash_rule.what: the hash rule, DERIVED here from the profile the bundle's shape names and then compared with the bundle's declared hash_tag (ruling T-7: re-derive, never consume)

correction_c6.why: the window is tn + 1 + bit_length(D_max) (D24) and C-6 applies exactly when that is a multiple of 8

endpoint.why: the endpoint commits the padded Dom::D cube in rows of 2^endpoint_log_n, plus MASK_ROWS = 5; an internal boundary has one more, the run layer's second reserved IO-tab row

tab_lift.why: ruling P-3 serves the byte table at the row width

corrections_and_geometry.what_this_is_not: a check of the prover.  These are three statements about the SHAPE, derived from its own seven numbers, and compared with what the capture declares about itself

pad_rule.the_rule: tau(log dom) + mu(base + n_pad) + nu + zeta(n_pad), with pad_on = any(Shape::pads(d)) over the domains the slot hosts (argument.rs:936, pad.rs:361-369)
pad_rule.what_this_is_not: a check of the prover: the capture's declared count is an INPUT.  What it predicts is that the port will consume exactly this many, and the gate's own confirmation is that the slot's terminal identity holds -- `Ctx.pad_draws` refuses BY NAME on any mismatch, which is finding M-F1's repair

receipt.the_law: a stage of a shape whose slots 16 and 18 have one degree less sends 528 bytes less per stage, everything else being equal

shape_independent_why.a_disclosed: A commits witness data under 36 opening groups whose blinding block is 246 rows at every shape so far; the disclosed dimension is a rank of the BLINDING structure, not of the data
shape_independent_why.a_groups: read from the shape, not assumed -- but equal at all three shapes so far
shape_independent_why.boundary_disclosed: ruling M-8's figure on the reserved rows
shape_independent_why.boundary_reserved_rank: 2*sites + 2 = 6 reserved columns over 2(G+1) = 6 generators, full rank
shape_independent_why.channels: the channel array is a property of the gate, not of the shape
shape_independent_why.h_disclosed: the public LogUp identity, and the gate checks that it IS that identity rather than assuming it
shape_independent_why.m_disclosed: M commits no witness data, so its part over the commitments' coordinates is 0
shape_independent_why.m_rows: layout.rs: M_ROWS = 2 * N_SLOTS + 4, a constant of the slot table and not of the shape
shape_independent_why.three_role_generators: 74 + 6 + 74: A's 2(36+1), the boundary's 2(2+1) and A's again

terminals.why: public_tables_included is True, so every slot's tables are carried and all 23 can be evaluated
